reproject_3d_points: reproject 3D points using camera extrinsic parameters to transform coordinates
project_3d_to_pixels: project 3D points to 2D pixel coordinates using camera intrinsics
sample_depth_at_pixels: sample depth values from a depth map at given pixel locations
extract_focal_length: extract focal length values fx and fy from camera intrinsics array
extract_principal_point: extract principal point cx and cy from camera intrinsics array
